title: Flaky telegram test TestApprovalCallbackDecidesAndEdits
body: Timed out waiting for edit (3s) in a full parallel `go test -race ./...`; passes alone.

title: runshim TestStatusReportsExitCodeAndStderr is flaky under load
body: Failed once in a full parallel run (exit code 0 instead of 3) and passed alone and with -count=3.

title: Mobile e2e silently reuses another worktree's preview server on port 4173
body: web/playwright.config.ts sets reuseExistingServer when not in CI, so with two worktrees running test:mobile the second run tests the first worktree's build, not its own. I got identical before/after screenshots until I noticed. Use a per-worktree port or reuseExistingServer: false.

title: test:mobile reuses any server already on port 4173
body: playwright.config.ts has reuseExistingServer and a fixed port 4173. With another task's vite preview already listening there, test:mobile silently tested that other worktree's build (spurious failures). Make the port configurable (env var) or fail when the served build is not this checkout's.

title: Playwright configs hardcode ports 4173/4174 and fail when parallel tasks hold them
body: playwright.config.ts and playwright.shots.config.ts use fixed ports with strictPort and no reuse, so two agents running test:mobile or shots:chat at once collide. Allow a PORT env override.

title: Playwright config hardcodes port 4173
body: web/playwright.config.ts fixes PORT=4173 with --strictPort, so parallel worktrees/agents collide and test:mobile fails to start. Allow an env override.

title: test:mobile fails when port 4173 is taken
body: playwright.config.ts hardcodes PORT 4173 with --strictPort; a busy port aborts the run. Allow an env override.

title: Playwright preview server port 4173 is fixed
body: web/playwright config binds 4173; if anything else holds it the e2e run fails with 'Port 4173 is already in use'. Use a free port or reuseExistingServer.

title: shots:chat fails when port 4174 is already in use
body: web/playwright.shots.config.ts hardcodes port 4174 with reuseExistingServer:false, so two agents (or a stray preview) running shots:chat at once collide. Consider an env override such as SHOTS_PORT.

title: shots:chat has no way to pick another port
body: playwright.shots.config.ts hardcodes 4174 with reuseExistingServer:false, so shots fail when another agent's preview holds the port. Read the port from an env var (e.g. SHOTS_PORT).

title: Fixed ports 4173/4174 in playwright configs collide with other running agents
body: test:mobile and shots:chat use fixed preview ports and fail with 'Port already in use' when another agent or run holds them (reuseExistingServer is false). I used temporary config copies on other ports. Consider picking a free port per run.

title: Chat shots and mobile checks fail when another worktree holds ports 4174/4173
body: playwright.shots.config.ts and playwright.config.ts use fixed ports with reuseExistingServer:false, so two tasks running shots at once collide. Allow a PORT env override.

title: Playwright preview ports are hardcoded and collide between parallel tasks
body: playwright.config.ts (4173) and playwright.shots.config.ts (4174) use fixed ports; with concurrent tasks `npm run test:mobile` fails with port in use. Allow a PORT env override.

title: playwright.shots.config.ts fixed port 4174 collides with another running preview
body: npm run shots:chat fails with 'port 4174 already used' when another worktree's preview is up. Allow PORT to be overridden by an env var.

title: npm run test:mobile picks up any extra *.spec.ts in web/e2e
body: playwright.config.ts has no testMatch, so a temporary spec (for example, a full-page copy of page-shots.spec.ts made to see below the fold) runs inside `npm run test:mobile` too, and page-shots.spec.ts has no fullPage option. The phone Overview puts the project band below Needs you, under the fold, so the standard shots never show it. A `SHOTS_FULL_PAGE=1` switch in page-shots.spec.ts would let agents see the whole page without temporary specs.
